info.title: fal/flux-3-max
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "fal/flux-3-max", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: Request body for Black Forest Labs' FLUX 3 Max text-to-video model on fal (blackforestlabs/flux-3-max/text-to-video): generate a video with audio from a text prompt.

example.prompt: A red panda walks along a mossy log in a sunlit forest. Ambient birdsong.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video. auto is 16:9 for a text prompt and follows the first image otherwise.

duration.description: Duration of the generated video in seconds, 5 to 20. fal bills per second of this value.

generate_audio.description: Generate synchronized audio. The price is the same.

prompt.description: Text prompt that describes the video and its sound.

reasoning_level.description: How much the model reasons about and expands the prompt before generation. high is slower. The price is the same.

resolution.description: Resolution of the generated video. 1080p costs more per second than 720p.

seed.description: Random seed. A random seed is selected when omitted.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description:
Comfy Router output schema for Black Forest Labs' FLUX 3 Max on fal: the terminal `GET /proxy/fal/blackforestlabs/flux-3-max/requests/{request_id}` queue RESULT document, forwarded unchanged. The operation is submit-and-poll on fal's queue — the submit answers a `FalQueueStatus` handle and the result route answers this document once the request is COMPLETED.
The generated video, with its audio track, is at `video.url`. `content_type`, `file_name`, `file_size`, `width`, `height`, `fps`, `duration` and `num_frames` describe the same file. Each is optional and may be null.
COMFY ROUTER DOES NOT RUN THIS MODEL TODAY. The catalog lists `fal/flux-3-max` and `GET /v2/models/fal/flux-3-max/openapi.json` publishes this document, but the operation has no `routerresult/classification.go` row, so `POST /v2/models/fal/flux-3-max` is refused before dispatch. The model is reachable today by calling `POST /proxy/fal/blackforestlabs/flux-3-max/text-to-video` and then `GET /proxy/fal/blackforestlabs/flux-3-max/requests/{request_id}` directly, which is where this document comes from.

content_type.description: MIME type of the video file.

duration.description: Duration of the video in seconds.

file_size.description: Size of the video file in bytes.

height.description: Height of the video in pixels.

num_frames.description: Number of frames in the video.

width.description: Width of the video in pixels.

FalFlux3MaxVideoResponse.description: Result of a completed FLUX 3 Max video generation.

seed.description: The seed used for the generation.
